Cors._comment: PLACEHOLDER — no production frontend origin exists yet for this project. Replace with the real deployed frontend origin(s) (e.g. https://app.yourdomain.com) before any non-local deployment; an env var override (e.g. Cors__AllowedOrigins__0) is the intended way to supply the real value outside local dev. Empty until then, so CORS denies all cross-origin browser requests by default rather than allowing an unintended origin.
